desc: The Rock Island Armory Magazine is a standard factory replacement magazine. This magazine is for MAPP Models chambered in 9mm Luger and holds 16 rounds of ammunition. It is made from high quality alloy steel. The exterior of the magazine features a blued finish. Additionally it is worth noting that the magazine is made to RIA's specifications and tolerances, using the same manufacturing process and materials as the original equipment magazines which shipped with your firearm. This will ensure not only a perfect fit but exceptional operation.
